answer: Stake-bonded validator admission at the zenith: each identity locks ≥32 ETH collateral, and admission requires the bond to exceed 100× the epoch reward. The anchor is a 90-day unbonding delay — collateral stays slashable after exit. Any duplicate-identity signal triggers slashing of 50% per proven sybil, so farming 10 identities costs 320 ETH plus forfeiture. Honest validators face no penalty; attackers hit negative expected value before reaching meaningful voting share. The mechanism works because sybil cost scales linearly with identity count while influence per identity stays fixed,.
